mapper.select: select oauth_id, user_id, provider, issuer, subject, user_name, email, avatar, create_time, update_time from sys_user_oauth_account where issuer = #{issuer} and subject = #{subject} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into sys_user_oauth_account (user_id, provider, issuer, subject, user_name, email, avatar, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{provider}, #{issuer}, #{subject}, #{userName}, #{email}, #{avatar}, sysdate(), sysdate())
